encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

καὶ προσκεφάλαιον, ἵν’ ἐς τὴν ναῦν ἐμπηδήσας ῥοθιάζῃς.
Β. ἀλλ’ οὐ δέομαι πανικτὸν ἔχων τὸν πρωκτὸν [προσκεφαλαίου].

div.note: Hesychius πανικτόν· Ἕρμιππος ἐν Στρατιώταις κτλ.

1. τὸν addidit Salmasius. κωπητῆρα Musur.] κοπητῆρα. 2. ἵν’ ἐς τὴν Musur.] ἵν’ ἐστί. ῥοθιάζῃς Blomfield. Gloss. Aesch. Pers. 402] ῥοθιάξις. 3. προσκεφαλαίου addidit Blomfield. ‘hortatur aliquis alterum ut secum navem conscendat ad bellum ut videtur profecturus.’ Bergk. R. c. Att. 324. πῆνος vel πᾶνος corporis tumores, pustulas et tubercula apud medicos significat. cf. Cels. 5, 28, 10. itaque πανικτὸν πρωκτὸν podicem tuberculis obsitum et cum contraria apud Hermippum sententia requiratur, οὐ δέομ’, οὐ πανικτὸν ἔχων scribendum esse opinio est Meinekii. ‘nihil se opus habere pulvinari dicit: neque enim pustulatas se nates habere’. mihi nescio quis militiae se subtrahere videtur podicem pustulis obsitum excusans: οὐ δέομαι (δύναμαι?) ἐμπηδᾶν μετὰ σοῦ εἰς τὴν ναῦν. ea de causa magnopere dubito an non recte addiderit Blomfieldius προσκεφαλαίου, pro quo dativum a πανικτόν suspensum (ἀεὶ φυγέθλοισι vel χιμέτλοισι, Cels. 5, 18, 19. 28, 10) desidero. de remigum pulvinari cf. Aristoph. Eq. 785. Cratin. 269.
